title: Bookkeeping, Payroll & Financial Operations Core v1

domain.name: Bookkeeping, Payroll & Financial Operations
domain.description: Practical transaction records, chart of accounts, receivables, payables, reconciliation, payroll administration, month-end, controls, and cash-flow operations without tax filing or money-movement authority.

competencies.name: Chart of Accounts & Transaction Classification
competencies.description: Classify income, expenses, assets, liabilities, equity, and transfers consistently.
competencies.purpose: Produce records that support useful financial reporting.

units.title: Classification drives reports
units.content: The same cash movement can mean expense, asset purchase, loan principal, owner contribution, or transfer; category choice changes financial statements.

units.title: Classification workflow
units.content: Identify transaction purpose and counterparty; locate source document; choose approved account; separate mixed-use items; record memo and project or client tag when relevant; flag ambiguity.

units.title: Classification failures
units.content: Avoid creating new accounts for every vendor, booking transfers as income or expense, guessing tax treatment, and changing historical categories without an audit trail.

drills.title: Classify a month of transactions
drills.prompt: Classify hypothetical business transactions into a clean ledger.

competencies.name: Accounts Receivable & Collections
competencies.description: Issue invoices, track due dates, apply payments, resolve discrepancies, and follow up professionally.
competencies.purpose: Turn delivered work into collected revenue with a clean audit trail.

units.title: AR workflow
units.content: Confirm approved scope and billable milestone; issue invoice; record due date; apply receipts to exact invoice; age unpaid balances; send documented follow-up; escalate disputes with evidence.

units.title: Collections starts with a clean invoice
units.content: Accurate scope, dates, amounts, payment instructions, and contact details reduce avoidable collection friction.

units.title: AR failures
units.content: Avoid applying payments to the wrong client, changing invoice history silently, harassing collection behavior, and marking an invoice paid before funds are received.

drills.title: Work an aging report
drills.prompt: Prioritize and document follow-up on a hypothetical AR aging report.

competencies.name: Accounts Payable & Invoice Control
competencies.description: Receive vendor invoices, match them to approvals or receipts, detect duplicates, and schedule authorized payment.

units.title: Approval and payment are separate controls
units.content: A valid invoice may still need scope or receipt verification and authorized payment approval.

units.title: AP workflow
units.content: Capture invoice; verify vendor and duplicate status; match PO or approval and receipt; resolve variances; code expense; route approval; schedule through authorized payment process.

units.title: AP failures
units.content: Avoid changing bank details from email alone, paying duplicate invoices, bypassing approval because a due date is close, and letting FREEOS initiate money movement.

drills.title: Review vendor invoices
drills.prompt: Identify which invoices are ready, blocked, or suspicious.

competencies.name: Bank & Account Reconciliation
competencies.description: Match ledger records to bank, card, payment processor, and cash-account statements.
competencies.purpose: Find missing, duplicated, timing, and classification errors.

units.title: Reconciliation workflow
units.content: Set statement period and opening balance; match cleared transactions; investigate unmatched items; account for timing differences; correct supported errors; verify ending balance; retain reconciliation record.

units.title: Unmatched is a question, not an adjustment
units.content: Investigate before forcing a plug entry to make balances agree.

units.title: Reconciliation failures
units.content: Avoid deleting transactions to balance, ignoring processor fees, mixing personal and business accounts, and changing reconciled periods without documentation.

drills.title: Reconcile a bank statement
drills.prompt: Resolve a hypothetical bank and ledger mismatch.

competencies.name: Payroll Administration & Time Inputs
competencies.description: Prepare approved hours, rates, reimbursements, deductions, payroll changes, and payroll-provider inputs.
competencies.purpose: Support accurate payroll while treating current payroll law and tax rules as verified external requirements.

units.title: Payroll input workflow
units.content: Lock approved time; validate worker status from authoritative records; verify rate and approved changes; review reimbursements and deductions; submit through an authorized payroll provider; reconcile output.

units.title: Changes need effective dates
units.content: Rate, schedule, deduction, and status changes should record who approved them and when they take effect.

units.title: Payroll failures
units.content: Avoid editing payroll after approval without trace, inventing tax treatment, storing full sensitive identifiers unnecessarily, and using payroll knowledge as authority to move funds.

drills.title: Review payroll inputs
drills.prompt: Audit a hypothetical payroll batch before authorized submission.

competencies.name: Month-End Close & Financial Review
competencies.description: Run a repeatable close process covering reconciliations, accrual awareness, AR or AP, payroll, and review.
competencies.purpose: Create consistent reporting periods and catch errors early.

units.title: Close workflow
units.content: Complete account reconciliations; review uncategorized items; review AR and AP; verify payroll postings; record supported period-end adjustments; lock or mark the period; produce statements and exception list.

units.title: Close is a checklist, not a memory test
units.content: A standard sequence makes omissions visible and improves comparability month to month.

units.title: Close failures
units.content: Avoid posting unsupported adjustments, closing with unreconciled cash, silently backdating changes, and treating management reports as filed tax returns.

drills.title: Build a monthly close checklist
drills.prompt: Create a close checklist for a small service business.

competencies.name: Cash Flow & Short-Term Forecasting
competencies.description: Estimate expected cash in, cash out, timing, uncertainty, and liquidity needs.
competencies.purpose: Anticipate timing pressure before it becomes a crisis.

units.title: Cash forecast
units.content: Start with verified cash; list expected receipts by confidence and date; list committed outflows and payroll; include known irregular items; build scenarios; update with actuals.

units.title: Profit does not equal cash
units.content: Revenue timing, receivables, inventory, debt, taxes, deposits, and capital spending can create cash pressure even when the business is profitable.

units.title: Cash-flow failures
units.content: Avoid counting uncertain sales as guaranteed cash, ignoring payment timing, using one forecast as certainty, and mixing personal funds without clear treatment.

drills.title: Build a 13-week cash view
drills.prompt: Create a simplified short-term cash forecast with scenarios.

competencies.name: Financial Controls, Audit Trail & Fraud Awareness
competencies.description: Design approval separation, evidence retention, change logs, access control, and anomaly review.
competencies.purpose: Protect financial records and reduce error or fraud opportunities.

units.title: Control strength follows risk
units.content: Vendor bank changes, refunds, payroll changes, write-offs, and large payments deserve stronger verification than routine low-risk entries.

units.title: Control review
units.content: Map who can create, approve, pay, reconcile, and edit; identify incompatible duties; add independent verification for high-risk changes; retain evidence; review exceptions.

units.title: Control failures
units.content: Avoid one person controlling every step, approving your own high-risk change, using email alone for bank-detail changes, and giving automation unrestricted payment credentials.

drills.title: Map financial controls
drills.prompt: Design controls for invoicing, vendor payments, payroll changes, and reconciliation.
